mapper.select: SELECT * FROM weekly_recipe WHERE week_key = #{weekKey} ORDER BY day_index, FIELD(meal_type,'早餐','中餐','晚餐'), seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_recipe(week_key, day_index, meal_type, dish_id, dish_name, category, people_count, portions, seq) VALUES(#{weekKey}, #{dayIndex}, #{mealType}, #{dishId}, #{dishName}, #{category}, #{peopleCount}, #{portions}, #{seq})

INSERT INTO weekly_recipe(week_key, day_index, meal_type, dish_id, dish_name, category, people_count, portions, seq) VALUES
(#{r.weekKey}, #{r.dayIndex}, #{r.mealType}, #{r.dishId}, #{r.dishName}, #{r.category}, #{r.peopleCount}, #{r.portions}, #{r.seq})
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_recipe SET people_count=#{peopleCount}, portions=#{portions}, seq=#{seq} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT week_key FROM weekly_recipe ORDER BY week_key DESC
